 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Prakash Chandra Gupta
 On The 11 th Of March, 2025

 Sanjay Singh Sindhare
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Ms. Priya Sharma - advocate for the applicant.

Ms. Neelu Khetra- Dy.GA for the State.
 Order

This is second application filed under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (in short "B.N.S.S."), for grant of bail to the applicant/accused, relating to FIR/Crime No.375/2024,
dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station-Badgonda, District- Indore (M.P.) for the commission of offence punishable under sections 376, 376(3), 323, 506 of the IPC and sections 3 and 4 of the POCSO Act.
After arguing for sometime, learned counsel for the applicant seeks leave of this Court to withdraw the bail application.
The other side has no objection.
M.Cr.C. is dismissed as withdrawn, accordingly.
(PRAKASH CHANDRA GUPTA) JUDGE ajit Sanjay Singh Sindhare vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27548560/
